run_fastcsp_full_workflow: run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config file and default stages
run_fastcsp_specific_stages: run the FastCSP workflow with specific stages like generate, relax, and filter using a config file
run_fastcsp_generate_only: run only the generate stage of FastCSP to produce crystal structures using Genarris
run_fastcsp_with_evaluate: run the FastCSP workflow including the evaluate stage to compare against experimental structures
run_fastcsp_help: run the FastCSP CLI with --help to see available workflow stages and usage examples
